interaction_contract: navigation immediately exposes the active workbench
every laboratory 00–12 has a one-click executable demo
successful demonstrations expose a visible result and persistent pass feedback
failures expose persistent visible failure feedback and retain manual controls
cross-lab compositions are persistent guided workflows with Back, Next, Finish, and Exit
Document to Data to SQL uses the real P6-to-P3 SQLite handoff
promotion_rule: Merge only after a metadata-complete candidate passes both the unchanged P12 gates and the new V101 interaction gates on desktop and mobile.
